target_profile: Linux x86_64, Python >=3.9, systemd --user; system Git >=2.34 for history
namespace_policy: not used; inherited seccomp no-connect required for SilverBullet and Git

installer.service_preflight: real transient user unit with NoNewPrivileges and inherited seccomp; no namespaces or capability changes
installer.repair: explicit plan/apply for recorded local-Git/IPv4-only wrappers; same core, preserved data, metadata backup
installer.endpoint_configuration: configure-plan/apply with paired service/public origin update and backup; no SSH tunnel required

packaging_policy.upstream_binary: offline rebuild from pinned source and reviewed patch; both checksums retained

binary_origin: locally rebuilt from pinned upstream with offline patch

offline_build.trace_coverage: all traced setup/server tasks and descendants; not only main PID
offline_build.local_git_runtime_tests: MCP status/history/diff/read/commit/restore; stale revisions and links refused; restart persistence; traced and without strace

network_compatibility.ipv6_unavailable_result: EAFNOSUPPORT at socket creation; reported separately from EPERM
network_compatibility.missing_ipv6_route_table: not read; route-based namespace checks removed
network_compatibility.service_isolation: ordinary user-systemd units; no namespace/capability directives; core/Git no-connect seccomp
network_compatibility.validation: real user-systemd wrapper update and endpoint reconfiguration; non-loopback IP HTTP browser (not secure context), OAuth PKCE/MCP/Git and restart; backend loopback only; inherited core seccomp traced
network_compatibility.direct_browser_access: explicit listen-host plus matching public-url; backend remains loopback; HTTP remote-origin browser fallback supported

ssh_mcp.authentication: personal password login over SSH; MCP-only hashed tokens
ssh_mcp.acceptance: real token issuance/export, default env and explicit file CLI over local loopback SSH, independent revocation and attribution; no OS credential store; corporate clients and native desktop stores require workstation acceptance
ssh_mcp.default_credential_source: MCP config environment; no OS credential-store calls or module loading
credential_sources: native OS credential store (explicit opt-in only)

agent_workflow.acceptance: OpenCode V1 profile parsing under isolated test; native context routing and closed GigaCode require workstation acceptance

release.target_acceptance: required; known MCP and client limitations retained
release.retention: previous release pages/assets removed by explicit owner request after verified offline backup; source tags retained
